chosen.title: exhausted man working in an office overtime
chosen.why: Over-the-shoulder back view of a man at a desktop monitor: back rounded, head pushed forward toward the screen, hands on keyboard. 0.3-1.5s is a steady hunched typing pose so the word reads on the first frame; no face visible; 1080p 16:9; no logos or watermarks (screen shows only generic UI). Downsides: dark, blue-tinted night office rather than natural light (saturation will be pulled down in grading), slightly handheld.

alternates.why: 3/4 side view of a man leaning into a desktop monitor in a night office; hunched posture reads but the face is visible and it is 720p only.
Frontal wide shot; at 0.8-2.0s the worker leans forward into the monitor, then stretches. Weak fit: face-on, 720p, reads 'tired' more than 'turtle neck'.

notes: Mixkit discover pages exist only for short tags, so the multi-word queries (office worker back view computer / hunched over computer / neck pain office / bad posture desk) returned nothing; 'tired office worker computer', 'neck pain' and 'working late' produced results. 'neck pain' results were clinic/physio clips with no monitor, so they were skipped. In-point 0.3 + 1.2 + 0.1 = 1.6 <= 12.01.
